explanation: This method is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because self.access_token is percent-formatted directly inside single quotes in the SELECT query. An attacker supplying a crafted access token could manipulate the query to bypass authentication or read arbitrary account records. The repair switches to an unquoted %s placeholder and passes self.access_token to self.db.get(), though safety depends on the unseen self.db.get implementation.
